title: An AI-First Proof of Concept: Simulating and Refining a Teach-Back Protocol for Dialogic Learning in Programming Education

contributions.purpose: 验证生成式 agent 能否设计并执行对话式 Teach-Back 教学协议
contributions.mechanism: GPT-4o agent 在单会话内自演 3 个模拟学生,对 C++ for 循环任务执行五阶段(后扩为七阶段)Teach-Back 协议
contributions.evaluation: 定性:3 个模拟学生均从表层解释进步到结构化、能处理边界条件(无量化指标,自演)
contributions.domain: AI 中介编程教育/对话式教学
contributions.source_quote: This AI-first proof-of-concept investigates whether a generative agent can design and enact a dialogic Teach-Back protocol for novice programmers.

contributions.purpose: 从模拟对话中提炼协议改进
contributions.mechanism: 对三段对话做轻量主题分析,识别误解与元认知时机
contributions.evaluation: 定性得出三项改进:新增 Slow-Thinking 阶段、批量改增量 Probing、新增 Transfer 阶段(无计数/编码信度)
contributions.source_quote: The analysis surfaced recurrent misconceptions and metacognitive moves and informed three refinements to the protocol.

contributions.purpose: 论证是对话结构而非模型规模带来学习增益
contributions.mechanism: 同一模型 GPT-3.5 上做有/无协议的组内对比
contributions.evaluation: 定性:无协议时学生被动、AI 直接纠错;有协议时学生主动重述、自我纠正(五维对比,无数字)
contributions.source_quote: it is the protocol itself—rather than model scale—that enables deeper reasoning, dialogic engagement, and metacognitive learning.

self_declared_provenance.quote: The Teach-Back method, although well-established in health education and other STEM disciplines, remains underexplored in computer science education, making this application a novel contribution to AI-mediated pedagogical design.
This study builds on these foundations by combining dialogic AI scaffolding with a revised Teach-Back protocol in a computer science education setting.

notes: 定性研究,允许非数字 evaluation,四元组套用略勉强(无实验对照)。核心红旗=循环自演:AI 同时扮演‘导师’与‘学生’、又自己做定性分析(checklist 分析=[D] 全 AI),无真实学生、无 ground truth,‘学生’必然进步;GPT-3.5 对比是 simulated baseline;单会话跨人格串扰风险(自认)。无正式编码/编码者间信度(自认)。但论文对上述局限极诚实,反复声明‘illustrative/hypothesis-generating/not efficacy study’,并释放全部 prompt 与日志——正因透明而 accept。GPT-4o 列为共同作者。
